zh.title: 美國航空人工智慧訂位軟體誤改行程引發反彈
zh.summary: 美國航空人工智慧軟體誤改延誤旅客轉機行程；系統運作異常引發反彈
body: 美國航空（American Airlines）近期因其新推出的人工智慧訂位軟體出現運作錯誤，正面臨越來越多的旅客反彈與不滿。該款軟體原先的設計宗旨，旨在當航班出發時間出現延誤時，能自動協助受影響的旅客順利銜接後續轉機航班。
然而在實施過程中，該人工智慧軟體在部分情況下發生錯誤重新訂位的狀況。系統在未事先詢問或取得旅客同意的情況下，逕行修改旅客的航班行程，將旅客改簽至較晚出發的航班，因而給出行旅客帶來諸多困擾與行程混亂。

en.title: American Airlines AI Booking Software Faces Backlash Over Erroneous Itinerary Changes
en.summary: American Airlines faces backlash as its AI booking software erroneously changes delayed passengers' itineraries.
body: American Airlines is facing increasing backlash from passengers due to operational errors caused by its relatively new artificial intelligence booking software. The airline's automated program was originally designed to make it easier for delayed travelers to catch their connecting flights whenever an initial flight departure falls behind schedule.

However, in a number of cases, the software has been changing passenger itineraries erroneously without asking the affected travelers beforehand. By automatically rebooking passengers onto later flights without securing their permission, the artificial intelligence system has created unexpected travel disruptions and generated significant headaches for affected flyers.
